title: Proactive spot-eviction mitigation and GPU stewardship for budget-sliced routing
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Implement a pragmatic routing policy that favors low-cost spot capacity while protecting latency SLOs and honoring per-customer budget caps. This ticket covers: 1) a route-scoring function that weights cost, latency, and spot-eviction risk; 2) a GPU stewardship layer that maps model variants to preferred GPU families (H100, A100, T4) with graceful downgrades; 3) budget-slice enforcement to stop or degrade low-priority requests when spend caps are hit; 4) eviction mitigation strategies (multi-zone hedging, warm on-demand fallbacks, and short-lived on-demand bridges).

Key design decisions so far:
- Use a normalized scoring formula: score = w_latency * (1 - lat_norm) + w_cost * (1 - cost_norm) + w_risk * (1 - eviction_risk_norm). Operators can tune weights per-customer and per-route. Default weights: w_latency=0.6, w_cost=0.3, w_risk=0.1.
- Eviction risk model: ingest cloud spot-termination signals + historical eviction frequency by zone/GPU type, produce a 0..1 risk score. We will ship a lightweight estimator first (bucketed freq by last-24h) and iterate to a logistic-regression predictor.
- GPU stewardship: maintain a small, editable mapping table (model -> preferred_gpu_families) with fallthrough order. Example: llama-70b -> [H100, A100], flan-t5-xl -> [A100, T4]. Routing will prefer preferred families but may pick cheaper families if budget cap dictates degradation.
- Budget caps: implement per-customer rolling spend window with hard-stop and graceful-degrade modes. Graceful-degrade sequence: reduce batch size -> switch to quantized model variant -> route to lower-tier region -> fall back to on-demand on short warm bridge if eviction occurs.

Implementation plan (high-level):
- routing/service: add route-scoring API and feature flag (feature: cost_aware_routing_v2).
- estimator/eviction: ship bucket estimator + ingestion pipeline for spot signals (GCE AUCTION, AWS Instance-Interruption Warning).
- steward/config: CRUD admin page in console for GPU mappings + JSON config stored in config-service.
- budget/enforcer: k-v per-account budget window, enforcement hooks in request router. Provide metrics and events (budget_exceeded, budget_degraded).
- tests: unit tests for scoring, e2e with simulator that replays historical spot-eviction traces.

Non-goals: full ML-based eviction predictor in this cycle, global autoscaling changes, or rearchitecting the core scheduler (we will integrate with scheduler via a thin policy interface).

Rollout plan:
- alpha behind org-scoped feature flag for 3 customers (DevOps team + 2 pilot accounts). Collect p99 latency, cost-per-1k-token, fallback-rate metrics.
- beta: enable for all self-serve customers with default conservative weights.
- GA: expose weights and budget modes in Console.

Monitoring and SLOs:
- Primary metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, cost_per_1k_tokens, spot_fallback_rate, budget_exceeded_rate, model_variant_switch_rate.
- Alerting: if spot_fallback_rate > 1.5% for >5m on production routes -> page on-call infra. If budget_exceeded_rate spikes -> page billing on-call.
